steps.action: After final independent build/input review, SFTP exact artifacts and verify all board-side SHA256. Record current v25/v16 identity, current serial access and v16 persistent fallback.
Run pinned updater check, then append --apply only after CHECK_PASS. Capture emitted BACKUP_FSYNC_VERIFIED directory.
Immediately use exact emitted backup path to restore persistent v16 selection; check first, then append --apply. Verify aliases and DT again before poweroff.
Clean shutdown, root-owned power/serial startup, interrupt autoboot. Paste the successful-v25 command with only explicit artifact release changed to v26. Do not save environment.
steps.uboot_command: setenv kernel_comp_addr_r 0x68000000; if mmc dev 0 && ext4load mmc 0:4 0x60000000 /boot/vmlinuz-6.18.63-t736-storage-v26 && setenv kernel_comp_size ${filesize} && ext4load mmc 0:4 0x64000000 /boot/initrd.img-6.18.63-t736-storage-v26; then setenv rdsize ${filesize}; if ext4load mmc 0:4 0x63000000 /usr/lib/linux-image-6.18.63-t736-storage-v26/allwinner/t736-gpu-candidate.dtb; then setenv bootargs earlycon=uart8250,mmio32,0x02500000 console=ttyS0,115200 root=PARTUUID=a0085546-4166-744a-a353-fca9272b8e48 rootwait rw clk_ignore_unused t736_mmc_pio.enable_hs200=1 t736_mmc_pio.hs200_max_hz=200000000 t736_mmc_pio.enable_hs400=1 t736_mmc_pio.collect_timing=1 t736_mmc_pio.hs400_max_hz=200000000; booti 0x60000000 0x64000000:${rdsize} 0x63000000; fi; fi

Historical GPU profile/runtime-check helpers remain bound to gpu-v15: do not execute or edit them in this trial, or claim they accepted v26. Do not combine Mutter candidate changes.
Use unchanged reviewed readonly-v4 against exact v26 vermagic, then unload.
Fresh small-file integrity before the frozen read-cost observation. The integrity output must be new; never raw-media tests. Capture full dmesg before/after.
Preserve raw records and compare total service/copy/command wait including new sync costs. Confirm persistent aliases remain v16; trial result is not automatic promotion.

limits: One-shot v26 boot does not provide automatic fallback after a kernel hang; root controls serial/power recovery.
Default v16 kernel/DT selection does not automatically restore any later GPU helper profile release guard.
v26 dma_start contains sync_device; post_reset contains sync_cpu; nested totals cannot be added.
CPU endpoints are not residency; dispatch crosses submitter/worker contexts.
